description: Polymer web component behavior for button state management, including properties, event handlers, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Polymer.IronButtonStateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of button state behavior including properties, event handlers, and observers.

methods.name: _tapHandler
methods.description: Handles tap events to toggle active state if toggles property is true.

methods.name: _detectKeyboardFocus
methods.description: Detects if the element received focus from keyboard and updates state.

methods.name: _userActivate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the button and fires change event.

methods.name: _downHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer down events, updates pointerDown and pressed states.

methods.name: _upHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer up events, resets pressed state.

methods.name: __isFocusedLightDescendant
methods.description: Checks if a target element is a focused light descendant.

methods.name: _spaceKeyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles spacebar key down, prevents default, sets pressed state.

methods.name: _spaceKeyUpHandler
methods.description: Handles spacebar key up, triggers click if pressed.

methods.name: _activeChanged
methods.description: Updates ARIA attribute based on active state.

methods.name: _controlStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to control state, e.g., disabled.

methods.name: _changedButtonState
methods.description: Hook for subclasses or behaviors to react to button state changes.
